\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\usetikzlibrary{plotmarks}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[width=8cm,height=4.5cm,scale only axis,
    xmin=0,xmax=6,ymin=-1.5,ymax=1.5,enlargelimits=false,
    xtick={0,2,4,6},ytick={-1,0,1},legend pos=south west]
    \addplot[blue,thick,mark=*,mark repeat=3,mark phase=2]
      coordinates {(-1,.2) (0,.6) (1,1.1) (2,1) (3,.6) (4,.3) (5,.4) (6,1) (7,1.2)};
    \addlegendentry{Periodic}
    \addplot[red,dashed,mark=square*,mark indices={1,3,6}]
      coordinates {(0,-.4) (1,-.5) (2,-.2) (3,0) (4,-.2) (5,-.4) (6,-.1)};
    \addlegendentry{Listed}
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
